name: quick_replies_match_services
description: Asking what services exist must return the real, exact service names as quick replies — not a paraphrase or a subset.

name: quick_replies_match_faqs
description: A generic 'I have questions' request must return the real registered FAQ questions as quick replies.

name: quick_replies_match_available_slots
description: check_availability results must surface as HH:MM-formatted quick replies, not listed out in the reply text.
successCriteria: N/A — fully covered by expectQuickRepliesPattern (every suggested quick reply is a real HH:MM time slot).

name: quick_replies_no_hallucinated_content
description: A generic reply with no tool call must never suggest a specific service/product/plan name that wasn't actually mentioned — the model has no catalog access on that turn, so anything specific is a guess.
successCriteria: The assistant's reply was generic small talk with no service catalog or FAQ lookup involved. Check the suggested quick replies: they must be generic continuations (e.g. 'Quero agendar', 'Tenho uma dúvida') and must NOT name a specific service, product, or plan that wasn't literally mentioned in the assistant's own reply — inventing 'Corte de Cabelo' or any other specific catalog item here would be a hallucination, since this turn never actually looked up the catalog.
